intro.headline: Realtime Space Travel
intro.paragraph1: You are the chosen one! You are humanity's last and only hope. This is not a game — our survival is at stake. This is our final chance: the promise of a new home in distant star systems. The ark carrying the future of humankind is ready to depart.
intro.paragraph2: The entire crew – scientists, engineers, the founders of a new civilization – has entered a deep, cryogenic sleep. Their fate, their dreams, our future... The fate of humanity now rests in your hands. You are the living, breathing component that no artificial intelligence can replace.
intro.sectionTitle: Your Duties – The Mission's Strictest Protocols
intro.rule1: <1>The Vigilance Protocol</1> – continuous visual monitoring is required to stabilize the navigation data. If your attention breaks, the ship initiates an emergency shutdown.
intro.rule2: <1>The Zero-Intervention Principle</1> – the systems are self-sustaining; manual intervention can be fatal. Your most important skill is discipline and patience. Do not act – supervise!
intro.rule3: <1>Real-Time Travel</1> – experience the authentic reality of interstellar travel. The stars shift over millennia; your greatest enemy is time.
intro.rule4: <1>The stakes: Everything.</1> No glory, no battles, no rewards – only silence, the infinite cosmos, and the responsibility resting on your shoulders. The future is reflected in your eyes.
intro.continue: Click or press any key to continue.
